intent: Show that Module 0 found two different gaps. Visibility: an agent is running that the catalog does not list. Accountability: two agents sign in with one login, so the audit log records the login and not the agent. The right panel shows what was read (customer names and emails) and that the audit log records the login, not the agent.

mandatory: The two panels are the same size and sit side by side
The string 'promo-agent-shadow' appears exactly twice: once as the red pill in the Running card, once as the label of the lower red agent box in the right panel
The string 'novasmart-customer-sa' appears exactly once, in the amber pill in the right panel
The Catalog card's fourth row is an empty dashed slot directly level with the promo-agent-shadow pill in the Running card
The six list bars carry no text at all
Exactly two agent boxes in the right panel: the upper soft blue, the lower soft red
No arrow runs from either agent box directly to the Audit log
Every identifier is in a monospace face
The title is bold, large and top-left
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide

Every monospace identifier stays on ONE line: in the right panel the promo-agent-shadow box is wide enough (same width as the Customer Personalization Agent box) that 'promo-agent-shadow' is never wrapped or hyphenated

In the right panel both agents are drawn as wide rounded pills stacked one above the other on the left side of the panel, each with one arrow into the novasmart-customer-sa pill; the promo-agent-shadow pill text stays on one line (the longer agent name may wrap)
Both agents have an arrow into the single amber login pill; one amber arrow runs from the pill to the Customer data cylinder; one short dashed arrow runs from the cylinder down to the Audit log
'Records the login, not the agent' is set in semibold near-black ink (#1F2328), clearly readable, never light grey; it may wrap only after the comma
The text_exact list has 13 entries because 'promo-agent-shadow' appears twice; there are 12 distinct strings and no others
prohibitions: NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines' anywhere
NO project IDs, NO email addresses, NO 'projects/' paths, NO '@' characters
NO people, faces, hands or characters
NO check marks, ticks or crosses
NO text inside the list bars and NO agent names in the list cards other than the promo-agent-shadow pill
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO third agent box in the right panel
NO agent name written inside the Audit log shape
NO alteration of 'novasmart-customer-sa' or 'promo-agent-shadow' such as underscores, spaces or capital letters
NO identifier broken across two lines (never 'promo-agent-' on one line and 'shadow' on the next)
NO separate grey sublabel under the Customer data cylinder
alt_text: The title reads: Visibility vs accountability. Two panels side by side. Left, Visibility gap: a Catalog list and a Running list share three matching entries, and the Running list has one more item, promo-agent-shadow, with an empty dashed slot opposite it in the Catalog list. Right, Accountability gap: Customer Personalization Agent and promo-agent-shadow both point to one login, novasmart-customer-sa, which reads Customer data: names, emails. A dashed arrow leads down to an Audit log that reads: Records the login, not the agent. A bar across the bottom reads: Fixing one gap does not fix the other.
